head: 4092c13860019ba7deec3741bc28c2984ad5fed1
summary: I finished the uat→SL-049 merge that stopped on .taad/fitness.yaml, keeping both sides. Each side had only appended after the SL-047 block. The resolved file is uat's content with SL-049's changes on top: first SL-053's settled rule (the rule-case suite never pins a literal settled-entry count), then SL-049's changes. Those are the two InteropLivesOnlyInNative except_files additions and the three settled cloud-files rules. No conflict markers remain anywhere in the tree (git grep exit 1). I checked the two slices' work together. rules-parity AGREE shows 36 settled entries under both shells. RuleCases C-001 to C-005 and SL-053's SettledCountProbe (all shapes) hold on the merged tree. The default `dotnet test` gives 332 passed with none of the Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT tests in the trx, and the whole solution, App included, builds with 0 warnings. No C# changed in this attempt.

files.why: Resolved the merge conflict and kept both sides. SL-053's settled entry (from uat) goes first, then SL-049's settled block (three cloud-files rules). SL-049's InteropLivesOnlyInNative except_files and because edits above the marker are kept, since they merged without conflict. No conflict markers remain. The file is resolved in the working tree but I did not `git add` it, so the index still shows it as unmerged (UU) until the engine stages it for the merge commit.

tests.note: Exit 0 under both pwsh and powershell.exe. Output: 'rules-parity: AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; 36 settled entries not compared'. 36 = uat's 33 (including SL-053's one) + SL-049's 3.

All checks held. It uses uat's derived Get-ExpectedSettled, which agrees with the merged yaml's 36 settled under both shells. Before this merge, the SL-049 side's RuleCases pinned '28 settled', which SL-049's three appended rules would have made stale. SL-053's derivation removes that.
All checks held. The appended copy expects 37 settled and gets it.

Exit 0, 'All checks held.' The shapes were AppendOne, AppendTwo, CountPlusOne, NotAgree, Misclassified, C003Base, OracleUnavailable, BothShells and GuardRule. GuardRule found SL-053's rule in the merged yaml, where it now sits before SL-049's block rather than last, and the rule fires on nothing in this tree.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test FsAnalyser.slnx --logger trx;LogFileName=default.trx --results-directory %TEMP%\sl049-build3-trx
tests.note: This worktree had no .dotnet/, so eng/dotnet.ps1 bootstrapped SDK 10.0.401 into the gitignored .dotnet/ (Q-003). Result: Failed 0, Passed 332, Skipped 0, the same count as attempts 1 and 2. The trx has 332 results and none from CloudPlaceholderTests. 37 are CloudRigTests, OptInTraitTests or RuleCopiesAgree results, all passed. RuleCopiesAgreeTests runs rules-parity on the merged yaml.
Build succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors. FsAnalyser.Core, CfProvider, FsAnalyser.Core.Tests and FsAnalyser.App all built.

tests.command: Select-String scan of src/**/*.cs, tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/**/*.cs (except CloudPlaceholderTests.cs, ArchitectureRulesTests.cs) and tests/CfProvider/** against the SL-049 settled patterns
tests.note: No matches, including in comments. This stands in for the engine's Fitness op=check, which I cannot run here because the TAAD engine is not in this worktree.
Exit 1, so no conflict markers remain anywhere in the tree.

This is the slice's real entry point, and it registers a real cldflt sync root under %TEMP%. Design open question 1 (may this run on this PC) is still unanswered, so I did not run it, as in attempts 1 and 2. This merge changed no C#, so nothing the opt-in Facts execute moved.

not_built: Nothing new was owed by this attempt beyond resolving the merge. The opt-in cloud Facts (stall and tree) are still unrun on this PC because design open question 1 is unanswered. That is a person's decision, not build work.
follow_ups: The engine needs to stage .taad/fitness.yaml (git add) when it commits the merge. I resolved it in the working tree but did not touch the index, so `git status` still shows UU.

RuleCases C-006 to C-014 (eng/rules-harness/harness.py) and the engine's Fitness op=check need the TAAD engine's python and checkout, which this worktree does not have. They were not run on the merged yaml, and validate should run them there.
Design open question 1 (may validate run `--filter Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT` on this PC) is still the only thing between this slice and real contact for Derived 3.
